title: Dynamic Nature of a Linked List

blocks.content: Dynamic Nature of a Linked List
Linked lists can grow or shrink as needed, which makes them great for situations where the size of data often changes.
In contrast, data types like arrays have a fixed size, so once we create them, we can't change their size.
To learn more, visit our Array vs. Linked List blog.
